profile.reading:
This building, SV6, is part of CoreSite's Santa Clara sub-campus at 3001 Coronado Drive, Santa Clara, CA 95054, per public property records; CoreSite does not currently publish a dedicated facility page or spec sheet for SV6, unlike SV1, SV4, SV7, SV8, and SV9, which do have live pages. SV6 is named as an existing campus building in a CoreSite press release about the broader Santa Clara campus, confirming it is a real, operating facility even without individual marketing content, so this entry does not assert an unconfirmed square footage or MW figure for it specifically.

CoreSite's Santa Clara sub-campus (SV3 through SV9) is described in a CoreSite construction-approval release as exceeding 775,000 square feet combined, part of a nine-building, 1.4-million-plus-square-foot Silicon Valley presence spanning San Jose, Santa Clara, and Milpitas. CoreSite is a subsidiary of American Tower Corporation (NYSE: AMT), which completed its acquisition of CoreSite in late 2021; Stonepeak Partners LP separately acquired roughly 29% of American Tower's US data center business in July 2022, later increased to about 36%. CoreSite's own site describes a total portfolio of 30 data centers across 11 US markets totaling more than 4.8 million square feet.

American Tower reported record leasing at CoreSite driving stronger-than-expected second-quarter 2026 results, projecting data-center segment revenue of $1.20 billion to $1.22 billion for full-year 2026, roughly 14.9% growth at the midpoint, and raising its full-year outlook on the strength of that performance; the company also budgeted approximately $695 million in data-center development spending for 2026, funding continued build-out including additional Santa Clara campus capacity beyond the currently marketed SV1/SV4/SV7/SV8/SV9 buildings.

reading.body:
CoreSite SV6 is one of nine buildings on a Santa Clara campus totaling more than 1.4 million square feet, but the operator does not publish power capacity for this specific building. Aggregator sources confirm the address as 3001 Coronado Drive and estimate the building at 136,580 square feet, but no megawatt figure has been found from the operator or independent sources. Without a published power specification, the building's capacity for AI workloads cannot be assessed from available data.

The Santa Clara campus sits within California's 11 published data center sites totaling 365 MW of announced capacity. CoreSite's portfolio ranks twelfth statewide by published megawatts, though this figure reflects the entire operator's California footprint, not SV6 alone. The state has 103 mapped data center facilities overall, of which only 11 have released power figures to public sources.

CoreSite operates as a subsidiary of American Tower Corporation following its 2021 acquisition, with Stonepeak Partners holding a substantial stake in the parent company's US data center business. Without operator disclosure of SV6's power capacity, this building cannot be ranked among the specific sites driving AI infrastructure decisions in Silicon Valley, despite its location in the region's densest data center geography.
